lines.beaver_en: Minsu, what's up? You look great.
lines.learner: 주말에 경주에 다녀왔어. 유적이 정말 많더라.
lines.en: I went to Gyeongju this weekend. There were so many historic sites.
lines.roman: jumare gyeongjue danyeowasseo. yujeogi jeongmal manteora.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, Gyeongju! What is it famous for?
lines.en: Gyeongju is famous for the tombs of Silla kings.

lines.beaver_en: Are there many artifacts too? Did you go to the museum?
lines.learner: 응, 왕의 금관 같은 유물이 많았어.
lines.en: Yes, there were many artifacts like the king's gold crown.
lines.roman: eung, wange geumgwan gateun yumuri manasseo.

lines.beaver_en: A gold crown! That's a really historical artifact.
lines.learner: 맞아. 우리 조상들이 만든 거라 신기했어.
lines.en: Right. It was amazing because our ancestors made it.
lines.roman: maja. uri josangdeuri mandeun geora singihaesseo.

lines.beaver_en: Do a lot of researchers come there too?
lines.en: Yes, I heard historians often come to do research.

lines.beaver_en: How did Silla begin at first?
lines.learner: 옛날에 작은 부족들이 모여서 나라가 됐대.
lines.en: I heard small tribes came together and became a country long ago.
lines.roman: yennare jageun bujokdeuri moyeoseo naraga dwaetdae.

lines.beaver_en: I see. What else do you remember?
lines.en: Cheomseongdae! It's a really historical building.

lines.beaver_en: Cheomseongdae is famous as a place for watching stars, right?
lines.en: Yes, I heard it's now designated a national treasure.

lines.beaver_en: You've gotten really into history, huh?
lines.learner: 응. 나도 이번에 역사가 더 좋아졌어.
lines.en: Yeah. I've come to like history more this time too.
lines.roman: eung. nado ibeone yeoksaga deo joajyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: Next time I want to go with you!
lines.learner: 그래, 다음에는 같이 유적을 보러 가자!
lines.en: Okay, next time let's go see the historic sites together!
lines.roman: geurae, daeumeneun gachi yujeogeul boreo gaja!
